name: Jeff Chavez
bio: Jeff Chavez is a Reformed Baptist layman and the founder of Theology Check. His writing focuses on covenant theology, 1689 Federalism, and the biblical-theological themes of the Particular Baptist tradition.

name: NoblemanPH
bio: NoblemanPH is a student at the Institute of Reformed Baptist Studies (IRBS) in Escondido, California. His academic interests center on soteriology and Reformed covenant theology within the Particular Baptist tradition.

name: Michael A. C. Justice
bio: Michael A. C. Justice is a scholar and theologian whose work engages critically with 1689 Federalism and Baptist covenant theology. His research examines the exegetical and confessional foundations of Particular Baptist thought.
